name: Harden draft lifecycle integrity
goal: Prove that draft creation/deletion is atomic, chain-safe, and approved without manual file surgery: (1) never manually rm/edit .synth/data/drafts/ files; all removal via CLI. (2) 'expedition delete' cleans up draft json+integrity files in the same transaction as the state mutation. (3) Fix --dry-run create bug that leaked draft file writes to disk. (4) Approved drafts are committed to the execution gate immediately rather than left as loose drafts.

metadata.refinementNote: Deliverables implemented: dry-run create no longer persists; delete and commit retire draft artifacts chain-safely (retireDraftArtifacts GC). Also raised reuse-and-templates spawn timeout 60s->240s: bootstrap takes ~44s on this machine, 3/3 false failures at 60s pre-change.
